main_visual_claim: Responder samples show coordinated up-regulation of the interferon module, while NonResponder samples show weaker or mixed interferon signal.

primary_panel.role: Main gene-by-sample z-score matrix showing expression patterns across modules and response groups.
primary_panel.justification: The heatmap carries the primary sample-level expression evidence and occupies the largest area.

support_panels.role: Thin sample annotation strip identifying Responder and NonResponder columns.
support_panels.justification: The response track is compact and aligned to columns so it explains grouping without competing with the heatmap.

support_panels.role: Thin sample annotation strip identifying batch for each sample.
support_panels.justification: The batch track is subordinate and reveals possible batch structure while preserving heatmap dominance.

support_panels.role: Narrow row annotation strip showing gene modules and supporting the interferon highlight.
support_panels.justification: The module strip is narrow, adjacent to the body, and helps decode row groups without duplicating the heatmap.

support_panels.role: Decode continuous z-score color and categorical annotation colors.
support_panels.justification: The legend area is outside the main body and provides necessary decoding for color scales and annotation tracks.

issues_found: Initial render placed row labels too close to the colorbar and overcrowded the annotation legend.
Second render improved row labels but left colorbar text too close to the legend.
fixes_applied: Added a dedicated gene label rail outside the module strip.
Widened the canvas and separated the heatmap, colorbar, and annotation legend.
Moved colorbar ticks and label away from the legend after the second render.
remaining_risks: The dataset is small, so sample ordering is intentionally simple rather than clustered.
